title: Mini bundt cakes
hookLine: Polish-inspired mini bundt cakes with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Mini bundt cakes
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Melt 25g butter and generously brush into the holes of a mini bundt tins. Tip a little flour into each hole and shake to coat, then tip out the excess. Beat the butter, caster sugar and a pinch of salt together using an electric whisk. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine the flour and baking powder in a separate bowl, then sift this into the wet ingredients and stir until smooth. Combine the cocoa powder and milk in a small bowl until smooth. Incorporate {m53304_1}, {m53304_2}, {m53304_3}, and {m53304_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Spoon 1 tbsp of the plain batter into each hole of the bundt tin. Mix the remaining plain batter with the cocoa powder mixture, then divide this between the holes. Bake for 15-18 mins, or until a skewer inserted into the cakes comes out clean. Leave to cool in the tin for 5 mins, then turn out onto a wire rack and leave to cool completely. Dust with icing sugar to serve. Incorporate {m53304_5}, {m53304_6}, {m53304_7}, and {m53304_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour 1 tablespoon of light batter into each mold. Mix the remaining batter with the stirred cocoa mixture and then fill the molds with a tablespoon.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake the mini Bundt cakes in the preheated oven for 15-18 minutes , depending on the size of the molds. After 15 minutes of baking time, use a toothpick to test with a skewer and, if necessary, bake for another 3 minutes. Let the mini Bundt cakes cool down completely in the tin. Then carefully remove from the mold. Dust with some icing sugar and serve. Enjoy your meal!
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
